title: CorMedix Reports Q3 2026 Revenue of $54.5 Million
summary: CorMedix reported Q3 2026 revenue of $54.5 million and a net loss of $14.7 million, kept its 2026 revenue guidance and narrowed its EBITDA guidance.
body_markdown:
The net loss compares with net income of $108.6 million, or $1.42 and $1.26 per basic and diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025, which included a one-time tax benefit of $59.7 million. The latest quarter included $11.5 million of non-cash expense from the remeasurement of contingent consideration tied to the Melinta acquisition. Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP measure, was $3.1 million, compared with $71.9 million a year earlier.


CorMedix narrowed adjusted EBITDA guidance to $130 to $140 million from $125 to $140 million and suspended previously issued 2027 DefenCath revenue guidance, citing recently announced changes to the CMS reimbursement framework. Cash and short-term investments, excluding restricted cash, totaled $355.2 million at September 30, 2026.


## Why It Matters for CRMD


The company described the quarter as reflecting "steady third quarter execution in the face of post-TDAPA headwinds for DefenCath." It also pointed to its planned acquisition of substantially all of the assets of Heron Therapeutics, announced on November 9, 2026, which it anticipates closing in the first quarter of 2027, subject to Heron stockholder approval, regulatory clearance and other customary conditions.
